rail.perpBlurb: Opens perp positions on Gate CrossEx.

recovery.workingMore: A deal is still working (+{{count}} more)

agent.wrongWallet: Your browser wallet is {{wallet}}. Switch it to {{expected}} to log in.
agent.notConfirmed: Boros has not confirmed yet. If Log in still shows in a minute, log in again.
agent.noAnswer: Boros did not answer. If Log in shows again, log in again.
agent.replaceBody: <n>{{from}}</n> Boros legs stay open. Its Gate perps show unhedged until you log it back in.
agent.noBuild: This build cannot place Boros orders. Trade the pair in the Boros app.
agent.notApproved: Boros shows no approval for this login. Log in again.

single.maxTitle: The largest order your available margin carries at max leverage.
single.postOnlyNote: limits rest post-only (maker fee only) — a crossing price is rejected and re-quoted; to take now, use Market
single.restsAtSub: post-only · fills only as a maker
single.partialDepth: Partial depth — the estimate is extrapolated past what the book shows.
single.marginTitle: Initial margin this leg posts — its notional over the venue max leverage

symbol.pickCoin: pick a coin to see its venues
symbol.searchSymbol: Search coin (BTC…) or paste a full symbol

impact.heading: Book & market impact
impact.legB: Leg B — market hedge after every fill

close.title: Close perp leg
close.sharedNote: This position holds {{held}} of the {{whole}} on the venue; the rest belongs to another position.
close.hedgesLong: This leg hedges the {{venue}} long leg. Closing it leaves that one unhedged — its funding stops cancelling and becomes a directional position.
close.hedgesShort: This leg hedges the {{venue}} short leg. Closing it leaves that one unhedged — its funding stops cancelling and becomes a directional position.
close.maxOwnedTitle: Close everything this position owns on the venue
close.exceedsShare: close size exceeds this position's share ({{max}})
close.limitPxTitle: Reduce-only IOC limit at mid ± slippage — fills what it can at once, never rests, never adds
close.bandTitle: The band on the limit: mid ± this much. What the book cannot fill inside it stays open.
close.bandHint: Max distance from mid the limit will accept. A wider band may be needed for a large size or a thin book.
close.bandHintShort: Max distance from mid the limit will accept.
close.reduceOnlyNote: Reduce-only — can never increase the position, never rests on the book. Its Boros legs stay open; the bundle shows as unhedged.

execute.viewOnly: View-only: switch to your logged-in wallet to trade.
execute.placed: Limit order placed. {{summary}} is resting on the venue until it fills — see Open Orders.
execute.replayed: This confirm matched an earlier submission — deal <n>{{id}}</n> already exists and no new order was sent. Showing that deal.
execute.marginBlocked: margin ≈ {{required}} (incl. 5% buffer + fee reserve) exceeds available {{available}}
execute.notMappable: can't run as one deal (e.g. unequal leg sizes) — execute the legs individually
execute.splitNote: two deals, one per leg (sizes differ) — sent in order; each leg reports its own outcome
execute.halfHedged: One leg is closed and the other is still open — the pair is no longer hedged. Retry closes only the leg that failed.

wizard.leaveWarning: The rate is locked but not hedged — until the perp legs open you hold directional exposure. The Positions page will show this and offer to finish the hedge.
wizard.lopsided: The rate legs are lopsided — {{size}} is unmatched. Continuing hedges only the size both legs share; the rest stays directional until you complete or close it.
wizard.oneSided: Only one side of the rate pair is on — that is directional exposure, not a locked spread. There is no shared size to hedge yet; complete the other leg, or close this one.
wizard.rateChanged: The rate legs changed since this hedge was sized — go back to the rate legs and continue again to re-size it.
wizard.doneThree: The perp legs are executing — the deal view tracks their fills. Your position appears on the Positions page, which watches all three legs from here on.
wizard.doneFour: The perp legs are executing — the deal view tracks their fills. Your position appears on the Positions page, which watches all four legs from here on.

deal.title: Deal <n>{{id}}</n>
deal.loadFailed: Could not load the deal — it may have been created by another session; check Open Orders / Positions
deal.deadlineTitle: Unfilled remainder converts to taker at the deadline
deal.unhedgedNext: Unhedged <n>{{size}}</n> — the engine hedges it next tick
deal.resolving: Resolving an order's fate on the venue — nothing new is placed until it is confirmed
deal.convertTitle: Cancel the resting remainder and complete both venues as market orders now
deal.repegTitle: Cancel and re-place the maker remainder at the fresh same-side touch
deal.customTitle: Cancel and re-place the maker remainder at YOUR price (snapped to the venue tick)
deal.stopTitle: Stop acquiring; hedge whatever filled; finish honestly partial
deal.resumeTitle: Retry the hedge and settle the deal (fix margin/venue first)
deal.crossed: The deal stopped — the limit price was already through the market. Try again from the order form with a fresh limit price.
deal.slipTitle: Short-leg average − long-leg average. Positive = sold higher than it bought.
deal.serverSide: The deal runs server-side — closing this view never affects it
